Authority.description: Who (or what) stands behind a claim, source, or revision. The Creator approves canon; AI proposes only.
Authority.title: Authority

Claim.description: A single assertion carrying a status, an authority, and its sources. A Revision appends a new state; it never deletes or overwrites a Claim.

confidence.description: Optional. Include only if computed or stated by the source; never invented.

Claim.title: Claim

ContinuityBundle.description: A top-level container holding any combination of sources, claims, revisions, and relationships. All arrays are optional; a bundle may hold any subset.

_note.description: Human-readable note, e.g. labelling the bundle's contents as synthetic/fictional example material.

ContinuityBundle.title: ContinuityBundle

Relationship.description: A directed link between two Claims and/or Sources, e.g. one Claim supports, contradicts, supersedes, or corrects another.
Relationship.title: Relationship

Revision.description: An append-only record of a status (or other) change to a Claim or Source. A Revision appends a new state; it never deletes or overwrites its target. The target's earlier state remains inspectable.
Revision.title: Revision

Source.description: A retrievable record a claim rests on. The hash field is present only when a hash was actually computed; hashes are never invented.

hash.description: Optional. Include only if actually computed; never invented.

Source.title: Source

Status.description: Frozen status vocabulary (Sprint 1, Deliverable 2). Exactly seven values; no additions during the first 90 days.
Status.title: Status

description: Sprint 1 (Directive CC-90-001) frozen definitions of the six Continuity Computing primitives: Source, Claim, Status, Authority, Revision, Relationship. Governing rules: Rule 1 no overwriting (corrections are additive; originals stay inspectable); Rule 2 generated is not established; Rule 3 authority outranks coherence; supreme rule: the simulator never becomes the source of truth; Rule 4 AI-assisted writing is still Noah's writing (authorship is not keystroke provenance). All example content using this schema must be synthetic/fictional and labelled as such. No sentience or consciousness claims.
title: Continuity Objects Specification v0.1
